title: Plan
description: One problem-named plan directory at docs/plans/<plan-name>/, containing <number>-<plan-name>.md, optional research/<report-name>/<files...>, optional tracer-bullets/<bullet-name>/ (with Dockerfile or compose.yaml and self-contained sources/fixtures), and progress/<plan-number>-attempt-<n>-<date>.md written during implementation, not planning. Editable in place until any attempt reports progress under progress/; reported progress freezes the plan, and resurfacing problems are written by copying <number>-<plan-name>.md to <number+1>-<plan-name>.md beside the untouched original. Repository rules outrank the plan

Number.description: The sequence number ordering the plan under docs/plans/<plan-name>/ and naming <number>-<plan-name>.md

Title.description: The stable problem the plan solves, in a few words; the directory <plan-name> is kebab-case named after the problem, never the solution (e.g. end-user-authentication, not oauth2-client-library)

Background.description: The problem and forces calling for the change, kept short and on point without repeating code or contracts

CheapestPassingInterpretation.description: The cheapest implementation that would satisfy a goal's wording while missing its intent, how the goal's wording excludes it, and the discussion register row accepting it

Goal.description: One prioritized, testable outcome expressing intent, paired with its cheapest passing interpretation

Goals.description: Prioritized, testable goals expressing intent, highest priority first

NonGoals.description: What is deliberately excluded from the plan so scope boundaries are explicit rather than inferred

Summary.description: Short prose explaining how the goals will be achieved

Assumption.description: An assumption the plan rests on and how it was tested (or that it was not)

AssumptionsRisksAndPreconditions.description: Assumptions, risks, and preconditions that must hold before implementation starts

ResearchReference.description: One research question with its short answer, evidence, and path under research/

References.description: Research questions, tracer-bullet links confirming or disproving assumptions, and negative findings or abandoned approaches

RejectedAlternative.description: A candidate alternative that was evaluated and rejected with evidence, linking to its decision register row

RejectedAlternatives.description: Alternatives considered and rejected during exploration

DiscussionRowRef.description: 1-based row number in the Discussions decision register

Discussion.description: One decision register entry recording the decider, the question put to the human, and their verbatim answer (never paraphrased); when the agent proposed the call, the human's verbatim approval is recorded

Discussions.description: Ordered decision register entries, including ADR conflicts and additions

OpenQuestions.description: Unresolved questions maintained during planning; empty or explicitly closed before execution

Milestone.description: One verifiable checkpoint executed in sequence; work outside the declared milestones is out of scope

MilestoneTitle.description: The short label and name of the milestone

MilestoneSummary.description: What the milestone delivers, stated without code walkthroughs or unmotivated file inventories

MilestoneVerification.description: The named, human-readable verification test proving completion of the milestone before moving on

GoalCoverageEntry.description: Maps a goal to the milestones that deliver it

VerificationCommand.description: The single command or script that runs all tests relevant to the plan, where it lives, and whether it already exists or is created in M1

ExecutionPlan.description: Step-by-step milestones, goal-to-milestone coverage table, and the single verification command; drafted only after all preceding sections are co-authored and accepted

ResearchReports.description: Research reports under docs/plans/<plan-name>/research/, one directory per report

ResearchReport.description: One research report directory at docs/plans/<plan-name>/research/<report-name>/ containing report files

TracerBullets.description: Self-contained experiment directories under docs/plans/<plan-name>/tracer-bullets/, each running inside a Docker container (Dockerfile or compose.yaml) with one documented command, no dependencies on the rest of the repository, and all temporary build artifacts kept in ephemeral container storage

TracerBullet.description: One self-contained experiment directory at docs/plans/<plan-name>/tracer-bullets/<bullet-name>/, containing the container definition (Dockerfile or compose.yaml) the experiment runs in and self-contained sources and fixtures

BulletContainer.description: The container definition file (Dockerfile or compose.yaml) the experiment runs in

ProgressLogs.description: Append-only execution attempt logs under docs/plans/<plan-name>/progress/, written during implementation, not planning

examples.title: Dry-Run Event Producer and Telemetry
examples.background: Events are disabled in production during dark-run verification, leaving suppressed events unobserved.

goals.statement: Emit isolated dry-run event counters without polluting production metrics.

cheapestPassingInterpretation.interpretation: Log a warning line instead of emitting a counter on a dedicated meter.
cheapestPassingInterpretation.exclusion: Requires emitting dry-run counters on an isolated meter distinct from production metrics.

examples.summary: Replace DisabledProducer with DryRunProducer owning a dedicated meter when event sending is disabled.

assumptions.statement: OpenTelemetry meter names isolate dry-run counters from production counters.

risks: Collector configuration might drop unknown meter names.
preconditions: Meter name is registered in the collector allowlist.

discussions.question: Should dry-run counters use a separate meter?
discussions.answer: Yes, isolate them on a dedicated meter.

milestones.title: M1 — DryRunProducer and unit tests
milestones.summary: Replace DisabledProducer with DryRunProducer owning its own meter and wire it when event sending is disabled.
milestones.verification: Run Release build and unit tests with branch coverage above 90%.
